description: Defines the AccountAssociations entity class for managing associations between loan and savings accounts within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: AccountAssociations
classes.description: Entity class representing associations between different account types (loan and savings) with methods to create and update associations.

methods.name: associateSavingsAccount
methods.description: Creates an association between a Loan and a SavingsAccount with specified association type and activity status.

methods.name: associateSavingsAccount
methods.description: Creates an association between two SavingsAccounts with specified association type and activity status.

methods.name: linkedSavingsAccount
methods.description: Returns the linked SavingsAccount in the association.

methods.name: updateLinkedSavingsAccount
methods.description: Updates the linked SavingsAccount in the association.
